skill.name: linear-automation
skill.description: Automate Linear issue, project, cycle, label, and comment workflows through Rube MCP with schema-first tool discovery.
skill.summary: Guides Linear automation through Rube MCP for issue, project, cycle, label, comment, and GraphQL workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP tool names and parameters. The real risks are the external Rube MCP trust boundary and the broad custom GraphQL mutation workflow. No prompt injection or malware intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External Rube MCP endpoint handles Linear workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Document the third-party service, OAuth flow, and expected Linear permissions before users connect their workspace.

remediation.issue: Custom GraphQL mutations can make broad Linear workspace changes.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer scoped Linear tools, request explicit confirmation before mutations, and describe expected changes before execution.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Linear connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `linear`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `LINEAR_LIST_LINEAR_STATES` - Get workflow states for a team [Prerequisite]
- `team_ids`: Array of team IDs associated with the project
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Cycles are team-specific; always scope by team_id
- Always resolve team_id before creating issues

content.user_title: Automate Linear Workflows Through Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Teams lose time on repetitive Linear issue, project, and cycle tasks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP Linear workflows.
actual_capabilities: Connects Linear workflows through Rube MCP after checking available tool schemas.
Creates, searches, lists, retrieves, and updates Linear issues.
Creates and updates Linear projects with team associations.
Lists Linear cycles and resolves team-specific cycle details.
Creates labels and issue comments, then edits existing comments.
Runs custom Linear GraphQL queries or mutations when standard tools are insufficient.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Linear OAuth connection.
Depends on current Rube and Linear tool schemas.
Cannot bypass Linear permissions, rate limits, or workspace policies.
Custom GraphQL work requires schema knowledge and careful mutation review.

use_cases.title: Triage Support Issues
use_cases.description: Create and label Linear issues from support requests with the correct team, priority, and description.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sprint Cycles
use_cases.description: Resolve teams and cycles, then organize issue updates for planning work.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Project Updates
use_cases.description: List projects, update project state, and align linked teams before release planning.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear issue for [team] named [title]. Set priority to [level] and include this description: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Update Project Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Linear project named [project]. Update its state to [state] and summarize the changed fields before applying them.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: List cycles for [team]. Find cycle [number], then identify issues that should move into that cycle.

prompt_templates.title: Review Custom GraphQL
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Linear GraphQL to answer [question]. Search current Rube schemas first, explain the query intent, and ask before running mutations.

output_examples.input: Create a high-priority bug for the platform team about failed login redirects.
output_examples.output: The assistant resolves the platform team and workflow states, then creates the issue with the correct priority value.

output_examples.input: Prepare cycle planning for the mobile team next sprint.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists mobile team cycles, finds candidate issues, and summarizes proposed updates for review.

output_examples.input: Find open billing bugs and summarize owners.
output_examples.output: The assistant searches Linear issues, filters by state and labels, then reports matching issues with owners and links.

best_practices: Search Rube tool schemas before each workflow because tool arguments can change.
Resolve team, state, user, and cycle IDs before creating or updating records.
Ask for confirmation before broad updates, custom GraphQL mutations, or comment edits.
anti_patterns: Creating issues before resolving the correct team and workflow state.
Using priority names when the Linear tool expects priority numbers.
Running custom GraphQL mutations without explaining scope and expected changes.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It automates Linear issue, project, cycle, label, comment, and GraphQL workflows through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it require Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. Rube MCP must be connected, and Linear OAuth must show an active connection.

faq.question: Can it create and update issues?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides team lookup, state lookup, issue creation, search, retrieval, and updates.

faq.question: Can it manage projects and cycles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, create, or update projects and list team-specific cycles.

faq.question: Does it support custom GraphQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run Linear GraphQL queries or mutations when standard tools do not cover the task.

faq.question: What should users review before connecting Linear?
faq.answer: Users should review Rube MCP trust, OAuth permissions, workspace policy, and mutation approval practices.
